description: Default capability for the main window. Vault access pattern: the user picks a vault folder at runtime via the dialog plugin; fs calls are then scoped to that folder by the web layer. V1 DEV ONLY: the fs scope below is a blanket $HOME/** grant so any picked vault works. $APPDATA is listed SEPARATELY because Tauri's scope globs never cross dot-directories — $HOME/** does NOT match ~/.local/... — and the durable stores (M1) live under app-data; without these entries every desktop vault boot fails with 'forbidden path' on its store dir.
